subject: Pilot: portal attestation automation — Brightleaf onboarding
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Alice Moreno <alice.moreno@brightleaf.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot: portal attestation automation — Brightleaf onboarding

Hi Alice — thanks for the time today. Per our call, Brightleaf is a great candidate for a small pilot to validate automated attestation reminders + evidence seeding into Vendr/Whistic (we'll scope the portals during the kickoff).

Proposed scope (high level):
- One-week dry run for QnA seeding (existing SIG/CAIQ answers)
- Automated attestation reminder cadence (14 / 7 / 3 days) with one-click attest flows
- Evidence mapping: seed 25 documents across S3 stub and portal attachments

Ask: can you confirm your portal of choice (Vendr vs Whistic) and a primary technical contact who can accept preflight uploads? If Vendr, we plan to use their API for bulk proof upload; if Whistic/Onetrust we'll use CSV manifest.

I've attached a short pilot_runbook_v1.docx and a sample portal_mapping.csv for initial review.

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Strategic Account Manager, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
Redwood Inference

Attachments: pilot_runbook_v1.docx (13 KB), portal_mapping.csv (4 KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Alice Moreno <alice.moreno@brightleaf.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot: portal attestation automation — Brightleaf onboarding

Thanks Vanessa — looping in a couple operational notes from our side that will affect the pilot:

- For evidence seeding to Vendr we need pre-signed S3 paths for attachments; suggested flow documented in pilot_runbook_v1 (see section 2.3).
- We'll run an initial QA job to validate CAIQ/SIG field alignment before upload (this is the qna_seed_v1.zip).
- Internal owners: please expect a short remediation list after the dry run — we usually limit to 10 low-effort actions to keep momentum.

Alice — do you have an S3 bucket/restricted upload location you can give us (pre-signed PUTs) or do you prefer Redwood-managed staging? Either works, we just need a decision so Markus can schedule the automation tasks.

Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot: portal attestation automation — Brightleaf onboarding

Marissa — I can take the automation tasks. Operational checklist I'm committing to for the pilot:

1) Validate and transform qna_seed_v1.zip into Vendr API payloads (2 hours)
2) Execute a preflight upload to staging using provided pre-signed URLs (requires receipt of pre-signed PUTs)
3) Run CAIQ/SIG alignment QA and produce a remediation list (target: < 10 items)
4) Configure attestation reminder webhook and verify one-click attest flow in portal

Alice — if Brightleaf can provide either a temporary upload role (ARN) or pre-signed PUTs by EOD Wednesday (2027-07-14), we will be able to run the dry run on Thursday morning and share results by COB Thursday. Otherwise we can use Redwood-managed staging (we will need a signed data-handback agreement).

Subject: Re: Pilot: portal attestation automation — Brightleaf onboarding

Thanks all — quick answers from Brightleaf: we will use Vendr for this pilot.

- Technical contact for uploads: security@brightleaf.com (you can reach Tim Park there).
- I asked infra to create a short-lived upload role; should have pre-signed PUTs available by 2027-07-14 17:00 PST.
- Confirmed: we prefer Redwood do the staging and cleanup; I'll sign a data-handback addendum.

Next steps for me: I'll upload the initial manifest (CSV) to the Share link below and confirm once pre-signed PUTs are live.

Thanks —
Alice Moreno
Head of Security Operations, Brightleaf
alice.moreno@brightleaf.com

Related link: https://share.brightleaf.com/drive/brightleaf_to_redwood/pilot_manifest.csv
